decisions.reason: A newly launched handle family whose value is still uncertain costs little to keep within a coordinated range made in-house, so the option stays open.
The mitred handle family has only one year of exposure and low carrying cost in an established catalogue, so it is too early to judge its value and abandon it.
The multifunctional handle fits the firm's barrier-free and system-solution strategy, which gives it option value worth keeping while demand becomes clearer.
A single lever handle adds little cost to an existing production and distribution system, so keeping it open is cheap while its results are still unknown.
The 1289 collection won the 2023 German Design Award and has its own page, an early positive signal that justifies further commitment.
A finish option can be applied across many handle families at minimal incremental cost, so it remains a cheap option to hold.
